## 0. Execution map

**Closing routes** — unmarked = `[C]`. Mark only what a session cannot close alone:

| Route | What it needs beyond the work | What a session can do |
|---|---|---|
| `[C]` work | nothing | close it |
| `[V]` verify | the real world (a deploy, a publication, a third party) | leave it standing + the exact query that closes it |
| `[O]` operation | a window, coordination, an access it does not have | leave the runnable checklist, do not fire it |
| `[D]` decision | the user's GO | bring the number that decides, not the argument |
| `[B]` measurement | a dedicated session | out of scope |
